title: Glowing strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b7a'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8192c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b80a1e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='innerGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3bb' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb3bb' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leafGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dff6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ecc40'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='36' fill='#ff6b7a' opacity='0.15'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='32' ry='32' fill='#ff6b7a' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- Strawberry body -->
  <path d='M50 22 C30 22 16 38 16 56 C16 74 34 88 50 92 C66 88 84 74 84 56 C84 38 70 22 50 22 Z' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Inner highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='18' ry='16' fill='url(#innerGlow)'/>

  <!-- Seeds -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='48' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='48' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='73' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='73' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='73' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='84' rx='2' ry='2.4' fill='#ffd966'/>

  <!-- Seed shine -->
  <ellipse cx='34.5' cy='47' rx='0.8' ry='1' fill='#fff8d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='49.5' cy='43' rx='0.8' ry='1' fill='#fff8d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='47' rx='0.8' ry='1' fill='#fff8d6'/>

  <!-- Big highlight spot -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25' transform='rotate(-20 36 40)'/>

  <!-- Calyx / leaves -->
  <path d='M50 24 C46 16 38 12 32 14 C36 20 40 22 50 26 Z' fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 24 C54 16 62 12 68 14 C64 20 60 22 50 26 Z' fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 26 C48 16 44 8 40 6 C42 14 46 22 50 28 Z' fill='#5ee84e'/>
  <path d='M50 26 C52 16 56 8 60 6 C58 14 54 22 50 28 Z' fill='#5ee84e'/>
  <path d='M50 26 C46 18 36 18 30 22 C36 24 42 26 50 28 Z' fill='#4cd93a'/>
  <path d='M50 26 C54 18 64 18 70 22 C64 24 58 26 50 28 Z' fill='#4cd93a'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='10' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#3aa82e'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='10' width='2' height='14' rx='1' fill='#6ee84e' opacity='0.5'/>
